page.layout: One page of running text, with a rubric line and heading between two paragraphs. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: postquam nauigio aduecti fuissent ad intemperantes Sirenes. Lacertis vero filium vinculis se constrin-xisse, quasi carcere quodam incuitabili, significat philosophiae secreta. Sirenas enim puto poesin fingere informes ac turpes voluptates. & admiror nimium in modum Homerum, commiscentem rebus veritatem, & cyceona nectare suaviorem auditibus nostris instillantem, non secus ac revera notham aquam vino alicui generosissimo miscoret. sic enim neque fabulis fallemur, neque ininitain-[?] comprehensibiliq; entium comprehensione mentem inebriabimus. quare per ceram quidem ignorantiam; per vinculum philosophiam intellexit. inde solum Vlyssem, tam suavia, supra ipsos quoq; cycnos audiuisse carmina fingit, & vinculis perrupisse viam. In malorum enim perspicuitate, constitit virtus philosopha: in voluptatum vero fuga, philosophiae é certamine comparatum tropæum. Quoniam itaque, Antimache, Vlyssis errorem hæc vita exprimit, ac in mare turbarum miser homo innatat, & circumstant nos Sirenorum[?] cantuum voces, ventorum instar modo hinc modo alia nobis non bona intentant, Penelopeæ coniugem imitabimur, firmum istud virtutum & diuinum philosophiæ vinculum prætendentes.
main_text.head: Rubr. ANTHINUS AMPELINO, LXXXIII.
main_text.p: Appropinquat jam vindemia, & musto ebriosa sunt acina. circumspicias igitur qua potes optimé in via publica, & cretensem tibi canem adhibeas comitem. viatorum namque manus continentes

page.notes: Left margin: show-through from the other side of the leaf, and the edge of the neighbouring page, are not transcribed. The word "ininitain-" at the line end is doubtful, and the hyphen continues into "comprehensibiliq;". "Sirenorum" is doubtful: the print looks like "Sirencorum". "generosissimo miscoret" is doubtful for "miscceret" as printed. The rubric "Rubr." is printed and transcribed as it appears.
